summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 25, 2026 press release detailing refinements to its China commercial strategy. The company will discontinue local production and sales of its 4008A hemodialysis system and exit its China peritoneal dialysis business while maintaining existing market obligations, and appointed Rex Liu as China General Manager. The actions are expected to generate about €110 million in one-time costs, including impairments, scrappage and termination charges, recognized as a special item in Q3 2026. China represents roughly 6-7% of Care Enablement segment revenue. No advisor, board recommendation or transaction pricing was disclosed. Watch execution risk, special-item treatment, and whether the charge affects 2026 guidance or Care Enablement margins.
